name: Middle Tennessee State University
oos_note: Public school. Non-resident (out-of-state) full-time undergraduate tuition & mandatory fees = $16,920/semester (12 credit hours) x 2 = $33,840/year, from official MTSU 2026-27 Undergraduate Registration and Mandatory Fees chart (mtsu.edu/tuition, 26-27_Undergraduate.pdf). MTSU financial aid COA page lists an averaged figure of $34,888.
